message: Every other custom error type introduced in this new package ends in `Error` (ConfigError, DeployError, CuratorStaleError), but this one is named `CommandFailed`.

The Asset.id doc comment says the id is "used in reports and by `--skip-asset`", but packages/deploy/src/cli.ts has no `--skip-asset` option (absent from parseArgs and USAGE) and packages/deploy/README.md's Options table doesn't document it either.
